notes.title: Endless Mode Update & Daily Deal Discount
notes.content:
Hello everyone,




The improvement update we've been developing for Endless Mode is now live! Additionally, you can purchase Toy Shire with a 30% discount between August 10–17.



Patch Notes


-Attic units and enemies have been added to Endless Mode.

The new soldiers, towers, and enemies introduced in the Attic chapter of the Story Mode (Summer Update) are now available in Endless Mode as well.




-Enemies now have increasing levels.

Since enemies could appear in large numbers in later waves and extend the wave duration significantly, we've added a leveling system for them. As you progress through waves, you'll now face stronger enemies.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195804/97e8eb5b76d2c8f895261b1939daca79e917ffc5.gif"]



-A level system has been added for soldiers.

Just like the enemies, soldiers now have a level system too. You can upgrade your soldiers’ levels in exchange for diamonds via the deck editor in the Endless Mode menu.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195804/ec7a312522b28575d59e9ed52a1b07e558fc3282.gif"]



-Balancing changes have been made.

We've made significant balance adjustments in the current version of Endless Mode compared to the previous one. Therefore, for a better experience, we recommend resetting your previous Endless Mode save. You can do this by using the new "Reset" button we’ve added to the Endless Mode menu.

Important Note: We’re aware that the leaderboard scores may seem a bit unbalanced since they were recorded in the previous version. However, we want to avoid wiping players’ progress with every improvement update. That’s why we plan to reset the leaderboard once Endless Mode reaches its most stable state with the Toy Shire 1.0 release.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195804/14be80f1337a8a40faf298ee20d7ae6be4541144.gif"]



-Several important bugs have been fixed.

We’ve fixed major bugs from the previous version, such as the fog not advancing in saved games and enemies getting stuck on the path. If you encounter any issues, don’t hesitate to report them to us!




Enjoy the update! 🎮

notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We’re excited to announce the new chapter of Toy Shire! The latest version includes a brand-new soldier and tower, new enemies, a new ability, and much more — all available with 25% off during the summer sale!

Summer Update

New Chapter – The Attic
After a long and tiring day, Kevin returned to his room to sleep. But unfortunately, he didn’t listen to his mother. The attic was the perfect spot to secretly play with toys. However, the old toys that had been lying there for years didn’t quite see it that way…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195804/4c503696efb7ddee5c63479631c86f72ce9fa7bc.gif

New Enemies
In the attic, you may encounter forgotten old toys. Not even Kevin remembers who they once belonged to.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195804/d6a80dade2a2ae4cee93462c393fa1bd5acfdd64.gif

New Units and Ability
New units joining Kevin’s green army, along with Kevin’s new ability, will prove to be quite useful in the Attic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195804/dee222e2cd0290328eca6b9753943003475248eb.gif

And of Course, a New Boss!
A powerful boss who wants to electrocute your troops is waiting for you!

New Achievements
There are 3 new achievements you can earn while playing the new chapter:

 Western Hero: Kill 50 enemies with the new soldier unit.
 Smells Burnt: Light a total of 30 matches.
 Calm After the Storm: Defeat the Attic boss.



Minor Bug Fixes
Several small bugs have been fixed to provide a smoother experience.

Important Note: If you've completed the game at least once in the previous version, it will automatically continue from the new Attic chapter. Please note that the new features are not yet available in Endless or Creative modes — we plan to bring these additions to other modes in the next update.

Enjoy the update! 🎮

notes.title: Spring Update is here with Controller Support and changes to Endless Mode!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

Toy Shire Spring Update is live! During the Steam Spring Sale, you can grab Toy Shire with a 20% discount. In this new version, we’ve made several improvements to enhance the overall user experience.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2361460/Toy_Shire/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget

SPRING UPDATE

Controller Support: You can now play the game seamlessly with any controller. We’re continuing to improve some features of controller support.

Leaderboard: We’ve added a leaderboard for Endless Mode, where you can compete with other players based on the wave level you reach. The player who reaches the highest wave gets the top spot!

Endless Mode Improvements: Based on your feedback, we’ve made several enhancements to Endless Mode:

 Added a save game feature.
 Added the option to choose the type of card to draw.
 Added a x5 game speed button.
 Fixed several minor bugs.


Winter Theme Removal: Some leftover winter-themed elements from the Winter Update have been removed from the game.

Minor Bug Fixes: We’ve fixed a few small bugs affecting gameplay.

Enjoy the game! 🎮

notes.title: Endless Mode available now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We’re proud to announce the first major update for Toy Shire! With the new version, you’ll enjoy a brand-new game mode, 4 new achievements, and smoother gameplay free of pesky bugs—all available now with a 20% discount during the Steam Winter Sale.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195804/80a02ca9823ca3051c5bb129abfc85a8a225d752.jpg

WINTER UPDATE

New Game Mode (Endless Mode)
In this mode, you’ll face infinite waves of enemies and test how long you can survive. It’s a rogue-like deck-building experience with no ending. Kevin won’t be present, and the mode has no connection to the main story. You can access it from the "Modes" section in the main menu. Have fun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195804/de679991926721d57d43d0f4b49af017d48ae81c.gif

4 New Achievements
Survival Novice: Reach wave 10 in Endless Mode.
Survival Master: Reach wave 50 in Endless Mode.
Lucky Deck: Draw 20 cards in Endless Mode.
Behind the Fog: Skip waves to push back the fog in Endless Mode.

Minor Bug Fixes
A few small gameplay bugs have been fixed for a smoother experience.

Enjoy the update! 🎮

notes.title: New Update with the Autumn Sale & New Bundles!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The latest update for Toy Shire is here! This update is focused on QoL features and making the game accessible to more people. Along with the update, the game will be discounted 20% during the Autumn Sale!

Autumn Update


 Steam Cloud Save Support: You just have to start the game once to have your save uploaded to the Cloud, and then you can keep playing where you left off on any of your other systems.
 Mac & Linux Builds: Speaking of other systems, Toy Shire is now fully playable on Mac & Linux as well!
 New Resolution Options: 1280x800, 1366x768, 1440x900, 1600x900, 1920x1200, 2560x1600, 3440x1440
 Head Shake Disable Option: We heard your feedback about the movement of Kevin's head. You can now disable the wobble effect.

notes.title: Toy Shire is Releasing in Early Access on August 26!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've been silently hard at work for the last couple of months, but now we are excited to announce that Toy Shire is coming out very soon! Toy Shire will be released in Early Access on August 26. Thank you for your patience! With the launch, we will also be running a 10% discount for two weeks, so make sure not to miss out on the discount during our release window!


Check out our Early Access Release Trailer below!

[previewyoutube=KS08RSTykds;full][/previewyoutube]


What's in Early Access?

The Early Access release version offers around 4–5 hours of playtime based on our playtests. Below, you can find a list of features that you can expect to find in the Early Access release.


 A total of 12 levels.4 rooms in Kevin's house, each with 3 levels to complete and a boss fight at the end. 
 8 types of towers and 8 types of soldiers for you to bolster your defenses or go on the attack with.
 28 types of basic enemies and 4 bosses. Each room has 7 different types of enemies and a unique boss at the end.
 Creative Mode, where you can make your own levels using more than 100 objects at your disposal. Share your levels or play levels made by others through Steam Workshop.
 More than 30 achievements to earn.
 3 different difficulty levels to cater to all types of players.


Shortly after the release of Early Access, we'll be making an update that introduces fun minigames and integrate Steam Cloud Saves. For more information about our future plans, you can check out our current roadmap below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195804/40fc3492476cfa0f49c1f28e5b6cb61e787ec2f1.png


Why Early Access?

As you can see from our roadmap, we have big plans for Toy Shire. In order to accomplish those goals, we figured it would be best to involve the community during that process. This doesn't mean we think Toy Shire isn't ready yet, we hope that you'll find that the game has enough content for now and is polished well.

We want to get your feedback on the content that's ready as we work on those big updates for the future. Your feedback will allow us to make necessary changes and fine-tune the balancing of the game, so that we can make Toy Shire the best it can be. For any feedback, please join our Discord server, use the Steam Discussions forums, or leave a review!

For more information about Early Access, you can check out the Early Access Game section in our store page.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2361460/Toy_Shire/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget

notes.title: Creative Mode Update & New Level for the Demo!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

We come to you with great news. We've been working on a new update for the demo version for a while now. Now that the moment has arrived, here are the patch notes!

What's New

 Creative Mode: Now you don't only have to play on the levels we made. With this mode you can create your own levels and even share them with your friends through the workshop.
 Level 3: The story mode picks up where it left off... For the demo version, we added all the levels in Kevin's room to the game. You can fight against different enemies in the table, bed and carpet sections.
 New Enemy Bases: There are different enemy bases that vary according to the different levels. You can also use them in creative mode.
 New Enemies: Meet two new enemies we added for Level 3.


Changes

 Balance changes: We've tried to balance the levels for the demo as much as we can. Of course, there are some balance issues in the current version as well. We plan to fix them as soon as possible.
 Level 1 Enemies Reworked: Instead of making Level 1 purely tutorial, we've transformed it into a normal game format after a few waves.
 Level 2 Redesigned: Due to our desire for a more controlled difficulty increase, we've redesigned Level 2.
 Soldiers Getting Stuck Issue: Soldiers couldn't hit enemies again after taking damage due to the damage-receiving animation until they died. Now, soldiers do not enter the damage-receiving animation except for heavy-hitting large enemies.
 Mortar Not Firing Issue: After the cannon stayed out of range after firing at enemies, it used to go into a zero-waiting time. This issue has been fixed.
 Many minor bugs in the game have been fixed.


You can try the new version by downloading the demo right now! Don't forget to report any bugs and suggestions you encounter in the game on our Discord server. We continue to improve the game at full speed. Have a good game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195804/06f927c7c3ed9908e0a9cc52b5d4069494cade40.gif
